changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/10743-studio-screen-visiblewhen-live.md`

- names `flow-expr-problems.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-expr-problems.ts` — edited by this change

  > - `buildScreenSpec` keeps every authored field and carries its `visibleWhen` raw, as the runtime `screen` executor sends it to the client. `ScreenView` — the renderer the flow runner uses — decides it live over the screen's declared fields and the values being collected, so ticking the sibling checkbox or typing a discount above zero reveals the field in the preview exactly as it does for the end user, and the "N fields hidden by their visible when condition" hint follows the values. - The Studio no longer has an evaluator of its own for this key: `isFieldVisibleWhen`, `fieldVisibility` and the simulator's `evalVisibleWhen` are removed. `buildScreenSpec` takes no `variables`; `hiddenFieldCount` takes the built spec and the collected values. - The Debug run's screen step judges SCOPE, never value: `unevaluableVisibleWhen` names, as an error on the paused step, a field whose predicate references an identifier that is not a field declared on this screen (a run variable such as `needsApproval == true`, the runtime's `vars.*` root), does not parse as CEL (a `{var}` brace), or is a shape `registerFlow` refuses — with the nearest declared field where one is close. A predicate over a sibling field (`discount > 0`, `record.discount > 0`) is not reported; it used to be named as "hidden because it could not be evaluated". A comprehension's iteration variable (`["a","b"].exists(t, t == note)`) is bound, not a root, and is not reported. - The Problems panel (`flow-expr-problems.ts`) judges the `screen` node's `fields[].visibleWhen` column by that same rule instead of the flow scope: it used to warn that `discount` "is not a reference in scope at this step" on the sibling-field shape and stay silent on a run variable; it now warns on the run variable (`needsApproval` is not a field on this screen) and is silent on the sibling. Every other expression slot keeps the flow scope. - The screen field inspector's `visibleWhen` placeholder is a sibling-field example (`createOpportunity == true`); it used to read `stage == "review"`, a run-variable shape. - `ScreenView` exports `screenPredicateScope`, unchanged, so the Studio reads the bare roots a predicate may name off the renderer's own scope; only the `record` namespace, which the renderer binds inside `evalFieldPredicate`, is restated by name.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `fda49e557` (merge-base with origin/main): 8 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1621 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2210 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36341958327)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4024c9b82619794df7fa8c7ea1a5cac047ec52c2`

### ① Derived judgments

**Sites 1 and 2: correct and complete.**
- `FlowExprIssue.flowScopeNote` passes `locale` to `describeUnknownRefs` and to `screenVisibleWhenScopeError`.
- `checkCel` calls `validateExpressionClient('predicate', value, locale)`.
- `checkScreenVisibleWhen(value, node, locale)` threads the locale to both callees.
- The Problems panel adds no frame of its own: `flow-problems.ts` forwards `ep.message` unchanged.

**Site 3: correct.**
- `screenScopeGroups(node, locale)` reads `engine.flowScope.group.screenFields`.
- `screenVisibleWhenScopeError` gains an optional trailing `locale` and formats with `tFormat`, which uses a replacer function, so `$` patterns in the arguments are inert.
- The en rows are byte-equal to the literals they replace.
- The Debug run's `unevaluableVisibleWhen` passes no locale, so it stays on the en rows. That is unchanged English.

**zh rows.**
- The Chinese is correct and the placeholders match. 页面字段 / 此页面 match the screen node's name, 交互页面.
- Nine type names reuse `packages/i18n` `widgetType` exactly.
- `metric` becomes 指标 (KPI) and `table` becomes 数据表格. Each follows its own en row; neither is a chart name, and both are disclosed in the PR body. So a zh author who picks 数据表格 later sees 表格 in the widget inspector. Not blocking.
- All 16 `engine.widgetPicker.*` en rows are byte-equal to the literals they replace.

**Reader split: sound.**
- The `AddWidgetPicker` entry name and search read `tr(t.labelKey, locale)`, which is the display.
- `DashboardDefaultInspector.addWidget` and `DashboardPreview.handleAddWidget` write `New ${meta.label.toLowerCase()}`, which is stored.
- The other readers read `.icon` only.
- No stored write reads a localized string, no display reads `.label`, and the `.label` values are byte-unchanged.
- Search matches the stored `id` and the displayed name, never hidden English. It is pinned under zh.

**Parse-refusal ruling: true on the card's surfaces.**
- `screenVisibleWhenScopeError` returns only producer text: `predicateSlotRefusal(...).message` (`@objectstack/spec`), and `validateExpression` / `collectCelRootIdentifiers` errors (`@objectstack/formula`).
- No copy of that text exists in objectui's metadata-admin.
- A separate objectui-owned frame wraps it in the Debug run's screen step (`flow-simulator.ts`). Every step note in that file is English, so it is its own surface and needs its own card. This is not a defect of this PR.

**Bounded in-place fix: inside the surface, same class, correct, pinned.**
- `localizeFlowFields` overlays `label` / `help` / `options` only, so detection and `getFieldValue` do not move. It is a no-op under en.
- It is pinned by the zh column-label case (显示条件).

**Pins (read, not run).**
- 21 cases in total: 12 zh site cases (exactly base's 12 red), 2 lit controls, 5 en controls and 2 stored-title controls.
- They mount real components, and the zh values are read from the catalogue. The ablation covers site 1, as ordered.
- Recommended, non-blocking: the en controls for the `engine.flowRef.notAScreenField*` rows pin literal hint wording. Role-file rule 231 bars that, and the objectui#10748 precedent reads `t(key,'en-US')` instead. Follow-up: switch to `tFormat(key,'en-US',…)`.

**Residual English on sibling surfaces** (outside the named sites, and without a carrier once `Fixes #10804` closes):
- `DashboardPreview`: the empty-canvas message, "Selected", three aria-labels, "Click to rename" and the `fallbackHint`.
- `flow-simulator.ts`: the Debug run step notes.

**Changeset `10804-designer-notes-locale.md`:** every sentence is true against the diff. Bullet 2 is narrower than the diff. Optional wording: "— a brace, bracket or dialect error on a CEL slot and on a screen field's `visibleWhen`, and that field's note naming a root that is not a field on the screen —".

**Pending family changesets:** none becomes false, and no dated note is owed.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, Clause-② no. `WIDGET_CATEGORY_LABEL_KEY` and `labelKey` are module-internal, since `widget-types.ts` is not re-exported and `exports` has only `.` and `./styles.css`. The new trailing `locale` is internal and additive, and en renders unchanged. Not `major`.
